additional_contracts: Same epoch and channel names coexist across distinct peers.
An abort before the peer binds stays pending, then reaches the matching late-bound call.

limits: Physical multiport coverage requires additional connected machines; Y/cyclic evaluations use the real bridge parent with simulated hardware adapters.
One deliberate QP retirement/reconnection was measured, not a cable removal or a long-term defect-rate study.
Local alternate routes are bounded repair paths; convergence under arbitrary simultaneous failures is not established.
Absent participants do not acknowledge aborts; cancellation metadata can remain pending. Lost process/shard state is not replicated.
No Gemma quality, throughput or analytical roofline target is claimed.
